display_name: LoRa W24 原生带外包级噪声条件与校准（冻结权重恢复预测）
description: Recover the exact Full source prediction matrix using independently spawned CPU workers and the exact original pair of frozen checkpoints.
authorization: Active LoRa DURA W24 goal, lawful source U_s same-waveform paired IQ, frozen W24 only after added source coefficients freeze, Full route.

code.environment: Archived N607 CVS-RFFI with exact registered W24 release

data.representation: Native 8192 complex samples; class scores use W24 8×2×432.
data.contract_ref: Pinned LoRa full packet native IQ contract
data.physical_ids_ref: Same 300 unique opaque source V packet IDs as frozen outer-objective source run
data.validation_ref: Native source split 392005. Disjoint 16000 U_s fit pool and 160 waveform holdout. Same physical Full 300-source panel and exact archived direct parity.
data.leo_config_ref: Full native practical and clean. Prediction uses generated receive IQ.

permissions.claim_scope: Source calibration and source screen. No F/TX/V/target access at fit or freeze. DURA and W24 checkpoints read only for their allowed roles.

checkpoint.initialization: Read-only exact r01 source-frozen weights. No re-fit, calibration or new weights.

sources.role: Frozen source predictions used as a matched comparison after both scratch candidates freeze
Pinned analytic aperture, tracking and generic waveform generator code only, no learned checkpoint

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Source frozen checkpoint binding and actual paired blind decisions must match the immutable prior source run.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: No historical restoration weight used in fit, freeze or candidate predictions. Historical outer predictions appended by unchanged physical order for post-freeze paired scoring only.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Freeze both arms at step 12000. Native half must beat parent+18 six, parent+10 low and direct clean, and beat matched aperture-power half on both practical criteria.

execution.gpu_policy: One N607 GPU, 3 then 6,0, >=12 GiB free and existing process cap. 8 CPU workers.
execution.stop_rule: No training. Stop on donor lineage/isolation, fresh worker real smoke timeout or parity, incomplete views or scorer failure.

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: experiments.pamf_lora_main.w24_packet_noise score-source via existing independent source truth-last

rows.method: Shared local aperture features and model, per-packet fourth input from either pooled aperture or pooled native high-pass power. Joint source log-disturbance calibration. Fixed half/full center and measured guard.
rows.seed_notes: No training/model seed or support. The 300 source V panel and waveform namespace are reused. Evaluation seed identifies W24 E104.
rows.budget_ref: Source-only replay of the unchanged frozen matrix. Zero updates.

notes: r01 training completed legally and weights remain byte-for-byte untouched. Its real W24 smoke passed, but the old fork pool stalled after the clean source view.
New freeze proof verifies the original exact code commit, source dataset and archive, classifier handle and zero role access. Same methods and decisions, fresh spawned CPU workers.
